author: GamingBolt
description:
While I recognise here that the devs might have achieved almost everything they set out to do with Sonic Pico Park, I’m not sure the game gives me everything I personally want. It’s a fun, charming little ditty that I’m sure will entertain me and my family for a while, but I can’t see it having the staying power in our household like Sonic’s mainline titles or the other chaotic party games that we like to play. 

Still, the joy of deliberately bouncing off a teammate’s head can’t be beat, even if that joy might be short-lived.
title: Sonic Pico Park PS5 Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
The sharper the steel, the colder the revenge, as they say (maybe), and when you first hear about Soul's betrayal in Phantom Blade Zero, you assume that's the main meat of the story. He seemingly killed Mu Tianmiao, his mentor and the Shadow Sovereign of the Order, an organization of elite assassins, warriors and kung fu masters with massive influence in the Wulin (a term for the entire martial community). 

His blood brother, Zhuo Shang, now the new Shadow Sovereign, and the rest of the Order hunt him relentlessly. In fact, when the story begins, Soul is working with a tainted heart and only has 66 days to live.

However, there may be a solution, revealed by the same mysterious Flesh Sculptor who saved his life. Soul ventures to Pangzhen to learn the truth and realizes that a wider conspiracy involving the Order and the Mandate is unfolding.
title: Phantom Blade Zero Ending Is Awesome, Here Is How It Sets Up A Potential Sequel

author: GamingBolt
description:
It's officially one week before Grand Theft Auto 6 launches, give or take a few hours depending on your local time, and to say that expectations are through the roof would be putting it mildly. Based on reports, estimates and Take-Two Interactive's own official statements, it's expected to be a massive hit. There's the benchmark by which future triple-A releases are judged. Then there's the one far above it, reserved strictly for Rockstar's releases, and based on recent estimates, it only keeps getting raised.

According to analyst firm Sensor Tower, which reported $751 million in revenue last week, Grand Theft Auto 6 has reportedly topped $1 billion in revenue. Apparently, 10.31 million copies have been sold, and once again, the PS5 is on top, comprising 75 percent of that total (or about 7.73 million). And as hilarious as it may seem that Xbox is so far below it, selling 2.58 million copies and earning about $250 million in revenue is still incredibly impressive.
title: GTA 6 Reportedly Earns Its First Billion Dollars But It Has A $20 Twist
